source: IMF PortWatch, a joint IMF and University of Oxford project
synthesis_notice: Recorded: the daily container port-call count for the Port of Singapore (portcalls_container) is IMF PortWatch data, unmodified, and one vessel arrival is emitted per recorded call. Synthesised: each arrival's TEU exchange, its transhipment share (connection_teu) and its time of day. No public source publishes per-vessel exchange volumes or berth-request timestamps for Singapore, so these are drawn from seeded distributions fitted on the calibration window only (2023-01-01 to 2024-02-29) and scaled so 2023 reproduces Singapore's published 39.01 million TEU. March 2024 is excluded from both slices as a buffer.
